Requirement: The system shall allow a member to borrow up to 5 items at the same time.
Acceptance Criteria: Borrowing a 6th item shows 'Borrowing limit reached'.

Requirement: The system shall set the loan period to 14 days.
Acceptance Criteria: The due date equals the borrow date plus 14 days.

Requirement: The system shall allow one renewal if no other member has reserved the item.
Acceptance Criteria: Renewal is refused when a reservation exists.

Requirement: The system shall send a reminder 2 days before the due date.
Acceptance Criteria: The reminder is sent by email at 09:00 local time.

Requirement: The system must block borrowing for members with overdue items.
Acceptance Criteria: A member with one overdue item cannot borrow.
